newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: BUENOS AIRES BOLSA PROMOTES LISTING ARGENTINE ADRS.
newsitem.headline: BUENOS AIRES BOLSA PROMOTES LISTING ARGENTINE ADRS.

text.p: The Buenos Aires Stock Exchange is promoting a project to list Argentine ADRs, a stock market official said Wednesday.
The plan also includes GDRs and Brady Bonds.
After due diligence trading is expected to start September 1, together with CEARs, a local equivalent to ADRs, that allow foreign companies to list in Buenos Aires, the official said.
"The ADRs's local listing will allow dealers a wider business spectrum and hence mean a significant increase in local operations," an analyst said.
Ten Argentine companies currently quoting also in New York could list their ADRs in Buenos Aires, in dollars.
